question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: an MCP initialize request (jsonrpc 2.0, protocolVersion 2025-06-18, clientInfo plumb-probe 1), Content-Type application/json, Accept application/json and text/event-stream, a User-Agent naming this agent and its homepage

decoded.challenge: present for the first time in this registry's records: a challenge (scheme Bearer) whose resource_metadata names the root well-known URI. On 2026-09-13, 09-18 and 09-27 the same request drew 403 with no www-authenticate header (artifact section 1)
decoded.protected-resource-metadata: unchanged: the root form answers 200 with the same 354-byte document as on 2026-09-27 (same sha256, 931362051d4c0378), six scopes; the path-aware form still answers 403 RBAC: access denied (sections 2, 3)
decoded.authorization-server-metadata: GET https://mcp.docusign.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server answers 200, 419 bytes: the issuer is now https://mcp.docusign.com, the URL it was read from, where on 2026-09-18 and 09-27 it was https://account.docusign.com; authorization and token endpoints still on account.docusign.com, grants authorization_code and refresh_token, PKCE S256, six scopes, no registration_endpoint (section 4)
decoded.tool-catalog: GET https://mcp.docusign.com/tools answers 200 with 70,518 bytes, sha256 4c09efd1fd397702, byte-identical to the 2026-09-27 catalog: 24 tools (section 5). The vendor's MCP tools page, read the same morning, marks 29 tools as available in production; the five it names that the catalog lacks are createEnvelopeWithDocuments, resolveEnvelopeSendMethod, getClmWorkflowDefinitions, startClmWorkflow and stopClmWorkflow. Which list a token-holding client sees is not measured
decoded.ownership: unchanged: /.well-known/public-agents.json answers 404 on www.docusign.com and developers.docusign.com, _public-agents.docusign.com TXT is NXDOMAIN (section 6). Changed: developers.docusign.com/llms.txt now answers 200 text/plain, 441,738 bytes; www.docusign.com/llms.txt is still 404
decoded.artifact-redactions: x-request-id and traceparent header values are replaced by a placeholder after the run; nothing else was changed

finding: The two defects this registry recorded three times in September are gone. A keyless MCP initialize to mcp.docusign.com/mcp now answers 401 with a challenge (scheme Bearer) that names the protected-resource metadata, so a client receives the response that starts OAuth discovery, where it used to receive a 403 with no challenge. The authorization server's metadata now names the URL it is served from as its issuer, where it used to name account.docusign.com. The protected-resource document, its six scopes and the 24-tool public catalog are byte-identical to 2026-09-27. The vendor's own tools page now lists five production tools the public catalog does not. No credential was used, no client registered, no tool called.

reproducibility.command: H=https://mcp.docusign.com; curl -si -X POST $H/mcp -H 'accept: application/json, text/event-stream' --json '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"plumb-probe","version":"1"}}}'; curl -s $H/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server; echo; curl -s $H/tools | sha256sum
